# KI: Circuit-Breaker Sandboxing & Manifest Schema Verification for Dynamic Plugin Ecosystems

## Operational Summary
Dynamic extension systems must prevent untrusted or failing plugins from crashing the host gateway. Enforcing manifest JSON Schema validation, explicit permissions gating (network_access, filesystem_read/write, subprocess), path traversal defenses, and wrapping every tool handler in a 3-strike circuit breaker isolates rogue extensions safely.
